ValidationRule.description: When both portions are entered, principal plus interest must equal the amount due.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Principal_Portion__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Interest_Portion__c)), Principal_Portion__c + Interest_Portion__c <> Amount_Due__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Principal portion plus interest portion must equal the amount due.
